nonduplicate_check.scope: repository search for temporal forgetting / checkpoint retention / training trajectory terms
nonduplicate_check.note: Historical Frank fine-tune planning is donor provenance only and is not a current Trigger-2 successor. This delta does not supersede the current Trigger-2 ledger or current GRID10/identity/transition blockers.

project_basis.observed: Positive training admission remains blocked; accepted_dataset_tokens=0; training_executed=false; checkpoint_winner=null; issue #2022 executable-transition supervision and issue #2021 checkpoint registry/gate contract remain open.

Checkpoint identity is available for BASE/POSTTRAINED/TARGET_MEASURED but no winner is declared; matched behavioral evidence is still partial and representation-level metrology contains a known instrumentation bug.

Current eval design already separates epistemic answerability from candidate correctness; this delta does not duplicate that axis and instead addresses time-local acquisition/forgetting during future fine-tuning.

external_method_research.source: Li et al. (2026), Temporal Sampling for Forgotten Reasoning in LLMs
external_method_research.finding: Across the paper's evaluated settings, models sometimes solved examples at intermediate checkpoints that they missed at the final checkpoint; more than 20% of final errors were once correct on average.
external_method_research.project_implication: A future Xeno fine-tuning pilot should preserve checkpoint-trajectory observability instead of treating the final checkpoint as the only evidence of whether a family was learned. This does not establish temporal forgetting in the current Qwen3.5-0.8B target.

external_method_research.source: Xue et al. (2026), Why Supervised Fine-Tuning Fails to Learn: A Systematic Study of Incomplete Learning in Large Language Models
external_method_research.finding: The paper reports heterogeneous incomplete learning after SFT and shows that aggregate metrics can hide persistent unlearned subsets, including sequential-forgetting and rare/complex-pattern failure modes.
external_method_research.project_implication: Trigger-2 evaluation should retain per-family acquisition and retention diagnostics rather than relying on one aggregate final score. This is method evidence, not current-Xeno evidence.

central_hypothesis.hypothesis: Final-checkpoint-only evaluation can misclassify a future small Xeno SFT run by hiding transiently learned then forgotten families or by hiding families that never become learned despite aggregate convergence. A preregistered checkpoint-trajectory protocol will expose acquisition, forgetting and interference before promotion.
central_hypothesis.counterhypothesis: For the small curated Trigger-2 corpus and exact 0.8B-class target, required family performance will be approximately monotonic and final-checkpoint evaluation plus ordinary validation is sufficient.
central_hypothesis.falsifier: Run one fixed-budget micro-FT only after current admission/source gates authorize it. Evaluate an immutable TRAIN_DIAGNOSTIC set and family-disjoint VALIDATION at preregistered checkpoints. Reject the added temporal protocol as unnecessary if required-family correctness/retention is monotonic within declared tolerance and final-checkpoint classification never differs materially from the preregistered best-validation checkpoint across repeated seeds.

proposed_future_protocol.training_data: Only canonically admitted training rows when positive admission is reopened; this delta generates none.
proposed_future_protocol.train_diagnostic: Immutable diagnostic subset selected before training, not used for gradient decisions except the preregistered analysis itself.
proposed_future_protocol.validation: Family/provenance-disjoint from training and used for checkpoint selection under a frozen rule.
proposed_future_protocol.final_holdout: Sealed until checkpoint-selection rule, evaluator, renderer, candidate identities and thresholds are frozen; never repeatedly sampled across checkpoints.
proposed_future_protocol.checkpoint_schedule: Preregister by optimizer step or consumed-token count before the run; include initialization and final checkpoint plus enough intermediate points to detect non-monotonic acquisition.
proposed_future_protocol.promotion_rule: No aggregate score may hide a failed required family/authority/retention floor. Checkpoint selection uses the frozen validation rule only; final HOLDOUT is opened once after selection.
proposed_future_protocol.authority_boundary: Checkpoint trajectories are model/evaluation evidence only. They do not mint S0 truth, admission authority, capability, effect authority, J-Space causality, HCU runtime credit or training credit by themselves.

interaction_with_current_training_design: Keep semantic decision, episode-local binding, executable cognitive transition and epistemic answerability/correctness as separately scored required axes where current project design already distinguishes them.
Track each required axis across checkpoints so a late binder gain cannot hide loss of authority integrity, abstention, state-transition correctness or exact-format behavior.
Do not use temporal sampling across the sealed final holdout; the purpose here is training-trajectory diagnosis and checkpoint selection under validation, not holdout maximization.
Do not interpret an intermediate-checkpoint success as proof that the final training recipe is acceptable if retention floors fail later.
Do not use this method delta to bypass issue #2021, issue #2022, positive-admission gates, physical GRID10 proof, J-Space metrology repair or exact checkpoint/input identity requirements.

artifact_lifecycle_effect.current_priority_change: NONE; attach this as required eval instrumentation before the first future authorized micro-FT rather than displacing current proof/identity/transition blockers.

next_discriminator: When current positive-admission and checkpoint-contract gates eventually open a fixed-budget micro-FT, preregister checkpoint cadence and per-family validation/retention floors before the run. Until then, do not create training rows or training credit from this method delta.
